ops.title: Ratified: HTTPS-only remote legs (reverses plain-HTTP-LAN)
ops.body: 2026-07-14, user-ratified after the P2 security review: every non-loopback leg is HTTPS-only. The LAN leg serves a self-signed cert on :25444 whose SHA-256 fingerprint travels as 'fp' in the pair payload (native clients pin it; browsers hit a one-time interstitial on the LAN leg and cannot register Web Push there); the tailnet leg keeps real tailscale-cert Let's Encrypt certs on :25443. The bearer token never travels cleartext. This supersedes the 'plain HTTP on LAN under NSAllowsLocalNetworking' clause of note 72c4359. Related agent-recorded notes: dc9ed76 (tension with the locked decision), 3fdde931 (LAN TLS design: separate ports 25443/25444, fp pinning, Config.Bind retained as the remote-access switch). Follow-up mandated by the user: plan extraction/unification of this access/pairing code with cc-present's copy — candidate homes: cc-interact, synckit (gaining an iOS component), or integrating cc-interact+synckit (tracked as session task P8).
